decision.rationale: All thirteen attacks the prompt names are refuted, and six further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v4 — was verified by opening both Stage A files: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX on subject f18f08bc…, the frozen v4. All seven citations recompute with zero mismatches. The non-unwrite span contains exactly D-167 through D-192, twenty-six entries, D-168 present, correctly extended by one over D-192's. Every live-state assertion holds exactly against the live file, and the lineage claim over D-170 through D-192 was verified across all twenty-three decisions. Two G18-specific hazards were tested hardest. First, DR-107 is the only companion row in this series whose token is not OPEN, so a careless 'DR-107 stays OPEN' was the most plausible substantive error available; the draft contains zero occurrences of PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW and makes no token claim about DR-107 at all, scoping 'stays OPEN' to DR-G18's own row, whose live cell does read OPEN. Second, g18 is the one lineage here with a REJECTed predecessor and a carried finding disposition, so the rationale was tested for omitting a landing; establishing from v3's own bytes that v3 already landed CLAUDE-G18LJ-V2-SF1 — its purpose reads 'Land CLAUDE-G18LJ-V2-SF1', it already rests on g18-input-corpus.v2, and it was reviewed ACCEPT 0/0 — shows v4 lands nothing new and the entry's silence is correct rather than a gap. Copy-forward from the four preceding cycles is absent, and the rationale matches v4's purpose clause for clause. Three further candidates were examined and recorded as observations because each is true as written. At zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields CONSENT.
